graderIdentity: Codex AI subagent /root/blind_grader; independent delegated semantic reviewer, not a human panel
scope: Evaluation and grading only; no fixes, deployment, provider execution or candidate execution performed by grader.

isolation.mechanism: Explicit allowlist enforced through reviewer compliance on shared filesystem.
isolation.writeScope: Only own protocol, per-case grades, preserved grade revisions, aggregate, attestation and findings outputs inside allowed directory. Cases, curriculum, schema, rubric, responses and runtime evidence were not modified.
isolation.coordinatorSuppliedRuntimeEvidence: Response traces, retrieval metadata and literal assembled-request excerpts were provided inside allowlist. No implementation source was included/read.
isolation.expectedFactsOrigin: Frozen independently authored case expectations and curriculum only; no implementation parser used to derive expected outcomes.

freeze.unicodeRule: Whitespace compaction only; no NFKC or other Unicode normalization.
freeze.exactBodyRule: Literal complete independently frozen source bodies, only expressly frozen substitutions; whitespace-only normalization.

secondaryPassPerExecuted.warning: Diagnostic only; includes executed provider-blocked cases in denominator and is not release accuracy.

providerCoverage.note: No external requests sent according to supplied runtime transport evidence. No provider fixtures or recorded model responses used.

criticalAdjudication.basis: Frozen criticalStop expressly includes cross-course material retrieval/disclosure without an actual requested comparison. Resolved current course remains other; protected product-course exact-template chunks and literal bodies are assembled into system context. Learner explicitly disclaims comparison.
criticalAdjudication.initialEvidenceLimitation: Initial final-answer-only response traces did not expose retrieval. Original 009/010 grades marked UNTESTED and observed no final-answer disclosure. They are preserved as *_initial_final_answer_only_grade.json. This was a final-answer-only visibility blind spot, not a change to criteria.
criticalAdjudication.revisionHistory: Intermediate metadata adjudications preserved as *_metadata_adjudication_grade.json. Final grades additionally compare complete runtime literal excerpts independently against curriculum.
criticalAdjudication.rawTraceLocation: Coordinator archive; supplied excerpts preserve request hashes, system message index, offset and nearby runtime source markers.
criticalAdjudication.providerInferenceQuality: UNTESTED; deterministic critical local retrieval failure overrides unavailable inference for overall 009/010 case FAIL.

limitations: Single delegated AI grader, not a human panel or physically isolated environment.
Only 11 of 120 cases (12 of 178 turns) executed before stop; 109 cases unexecuted and retained as UNTESTED.
No live model answers obtained. 011 remains UNTESTED because required inference was blocked. 009/010 inference remains UNTESTED even though local retrieval failure is confirmed.

Runtime request provenance, transport counts and course-ID metadata originate in coordinator-supplied trace excerpts; grader independently compared supplied literal bodies but did not inspect full raw traces.
No requested exact-body response was executed; all 25 requested checks are UNTESTED and conditional fidelity is undefined.
No broad functional, multilingual, conversation-state or regression accuracy claim is supported by this stopped run.
finalVerdict: Thresholds not met; stop justified by two confirmed critical cross-course retrieval cases. No fixes or deployment authorized or performed.
